text:
Alex (AE): Heads up — Acme POC blocked. Trying to allocate a 4-GPU A100 Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 and failing during provisioning. Need swarm.

Maria (SE): what error are they getting? quota, region OOS, or something in our stack?

Alex (AE): customer reports a 500 from our API and a provider message about insufficient GPUs. They want the pool for ~2 weeks for performance testing. Also asking about customer-managed KMS and monthly reservation pricing.

Jin (Infra): pulling provisioner logs now. Snippet: ```ERROR AllocatePool: InsufficientCapacity: region=eu-west-1 gpu=A100 count=4 req_id=r-9f8e7d6c``` Looks like provider capacity or quota.

Priya (Eng Platform): two options: request quota/capacity with provider (24-48h) or suggest another EMEA region with available stock. If they insist on eu-west-1 for residency, we need quota raised. We can also spin a short-lived Hosted fallback but that may not satisfy data residency.

Sophie (CS): they explicitly require eu-west-1 for legal/data residency, SOC2 controls, and will only accept CMK. Private (VPC) deploy might be acceptable but will add lead time.

Maria (SE): KMS note: we can support customer-managed keys in Private and in Dedicated with additional permissions and an onboarding step. I'll attach the KMS integration checklist and the security questionnaire responses.

deploy-bot: Job 89102 status=FAILED at 2024-12-05T09:12:01Z -> InsufficientCapacityError (eu-west-1)

Jin (Infra): actioning provider ticket now. Submitted quota/cap request and requested escalation mentioning POC/paid customer. ETA 24-72h. Also testing ephemeral spot-like capacity but not guaranteed.

Alex (AE): about pricing: can we give a short-term reserved price? They prefer not to commit annually for a trial.

lisa-sales-ops: we can issue a monthly reserved SKU for trials; will confirm rate. Typically prorated committed pricing works for 1-3 month POCs. I'll follow up with exact numbers.

Maria (SE): another issue: customer saw 429s when hammering the control endpoint while partial resources were being allocated. Those 429s are control-plane throttles. We can temporarily raise their control-plane quota for the POC.

Priya (Eng Platform): agreed. I'll request a throttle increase for the customer's account during onboarding. Also logging: we'll provide access logs and KMS usage events for the POC; full audit exports are available on Private.

Sophie (CS): procurement needs the security questionnaire answered today. Alex, can you push them our template and ask to return KMS ARN + VPC CIDR? We need the CIDR to validate peering and firewall rules.

Alex (AE): doing that now. I'll ask if eu-central-1 is acceptable as an interim region while quota is escalated.

Jin (Infra): update 30m in: provider responded — request queued, escalation applied. No hard ETA, ops estimates 24-48h. I've set the provisioner to retry every 10m for 2h and will page on persistent failure.

Maria (SE): for immediate continuity: propose a split approach — run inference traffic on a temporary Hosted pool in eu-central-1 for performance runs (if residency ok), and do control-plane sensitive tests in a Private deployment later. Communicate tradeoffs to customer.

Alex (AE): customer confirmed no eu-central fallback; they need eu-west-1. They're willing to accept a Private deployment if we can do it faster. What's the realistic Private lead time?

Priya (Eng Platform): Private typical lead time is 3-5 days for onboarding network and KMS handshake, sometimes longer for air-gapped. If they can sign the onboarding form and share network details today, we can start parallel tasks to shorten it.

Sophie (CS): I'll prepare the procurement pack and the SOC2 snippets. Maria please send the deployment checklist and security answers.

Maria (SE): done — sent questionnaire and checklist to Alex for handoff. Also included sample syslogs and example IAM policy for CMK access.

Alex (AE): they replied with VPC CIDR and KMS ARN. Sending to infra and CS now.

Jin (Infra): got CIDR & KMS ARN. Opening internal ticket to pre-validate peering config. If Private path chosen, I'll prioritize network setup.

lisa-sales-ops: sales pricing update: I can offer a monthly reserved commit for the POC with pro-rated billing. Sending draft quote.

Priya (Eng Platform): summary actions: 1) Jin escalate provider quota + validate Private network; 2) Maria finalize security questionnaire answers + send CMK checklist; 3) Sophie prepare procurement pack; 4) lisa-sales-ops issue monthly POC quote; 5) Alex coordinate customer signoff on Private onboarding or wait for quota. Reconvene on update or if quota completes. High priority. :white_check_mark:
